title: Gómez Suárez de Figueroa, Genoa: cipher letters 1534-1557 (AGS Estado 1367-1386, catalogue 744): keys found in Tomokiyo for 18 of 20 items; no ciphertext in hand yet

system.summary: Not seen by this project; Tomokiyo assigns 18 of the 20 items to four ciphers (a simple substitution of 1529-1538 and three vowel-indicator syllabic ciphers of 1543, 1544-1554 and 1548).
system.notes: System fields are unknown because no image was opened in the profiled session; see NOTES.md and prior_art.tsv.

prior_solution.where: Keys (not readings) reconstructed by S. Tomokiyo, cryptiana.web.fc2.com/code/spanish2.htm, for the four ciphers covering 18 of the 20 items; the 1544-1554 key after Meister (1906) and Bertomeu Masiá (2009). No printed reading of the letters found.

conditions.human_role: Set the task (the catalogue 744 solve page); no other input.

solution.what: PARES record and image pages for the 20 items: connection reset and HTTP 429 from this machine; no image fetched.

Web search and Tomokiyo's 'Spanish Ciphers during the Reign of Emperor Charles V': 18 of the 20 PARES records are listed there under four ciphers with reconstructed keys (prior_art.tsv); the 2 Nov 2026 vetting had missed it.
Tomokiyo's key images (CharlesV1534.jpg, CharlesV1543.jpg, CharlesV2.jpg, CharlesV3.gif, CharlesV1548.jpg): direct download redirected, images not read.

outcome.method_basis: No ciphertext was obtained (PARES unreachable), so nothing was attempted; keys exist in print (Tomokiyo) and were not in hand either.

credits.note: His article lists 18 of the 20 records by PARES number, assigns each to a cipher and shows the reconstructed keys.

gaps.detail: No images: PARES refused this session's machine on 11 Nov 2026.
